999008199.text:
（地図を見たところ、線路が通ってる
　坑道があるみたい。そこを使うんだって）

localizations.en: (Judging from the map, there seems to be a tunnel with train tracks running through it. That's what we'll use to our advantage.)

999008199.text:
（まず、足の速いヨハナが人造頂獣を追う。
　そして、目的の坑道へと誘導する）

localizations.en: (First, Johanna, being the fastest, will chase the man-made Apexi and lure it to our target tunnel.)

999008199.text:
（もちろん、一本道じゃないから、目的地じゃない方の
　道に行かないように残りの仲間で塞ぐ）

localizations.en: (Of course, since it's not a straight path, the rest of us will cut it off to prevent it from going down another path.)

999008199.text:
（そうして目的の坑道に追い込んだら、
　トロッコを走らせる……爆薬を積んで）

localizations.en: (Once we've cornered it in the target tunnel, we'll send a mine cart down the tracks... loaded with explosives.)

999008199.text:
（そうすれば、強力な爆薬を安全に
　人造頂獣の所まで送ることができる！）

localizations.en: (That way, we can safely deliver powerful explosives right to its doorstep!)

999008199.text:
（掘削計画書の資料から、周辺の天井の
　脆い場所と安全な場所も確認済み）

localizations.en: (From the excavation schematics, we've already identified which ceiling areas are fragile and which are sound.)

999008199.text:
（その脆い場所で爆薬を起爆。
　天井を崩落させ、人造頂獣に覆いかぶせる！）

localizations.en: (We'll detonate the explosives at the fault lines. The ceiling will collapse and trap the man-made Apexi underneath!)

999008199.text: ちっ……これでもピンピンしてるのかよ！

localizations.en: Tch... Don't tell me that thing's still kicking!

999008199.text:
でも、無傷じゃないみたいだよ。
それに、もう逃げる気もなさそうだ

localizations.en: But it doesn't look unharmed. And it doesn't seem like it wants to run away anymore.

999008199.text: 決着をつけよう！　アタシたちなら倒せるよ！

localizations.en: Let's finish this! We can defeat it together!

999008199.text:
思い知らせてやろうじゃない！
私たちの団結力ってやつを！

localizations.en: Time to show it what we're made of! This is the power of our teamwork!
